_about: Public-domain Charles Wagner (1852-1918), Alsatian-born liberal Reformed pastor in Paris, in English translation, for the Word Hoard: Youth, Courage, The Simple Life, The Better Way, By the Fireside, and The Voice of Nature. This shelf is English only. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 104 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
